title: Proton Unlimited – Swiss Privacy Suite
text: Encrypted email, ultra-fast VPN, 500GB secure cloud drive, and password manager. Zero logs, Swiss privacy laws.

title: NordVPN – Threat Protection & Private Browsing
text: Block malware, intrusive trackers, and bypass geographic restrictions with high-speed 10Gbps encrypted servers.

title: DigitalOcean – $200 Free Cloud Credit
text: Spin up self-hosted open-source software (Nextcloud, Vaultwarden, Ghost, Docker) in seconds on scalable cloud droplets.

title: Hetzner Cloud – High Performance European Servers
text: Ultra-affordable, dedicated and cloud VPS servers starting at just €4/month. Perfect for hosting open-source apps.

title: pCloud – Lifetime Cloud Storage (Zero Subscriptions)
text: Pay once, keep forever. Up to 10TB of encrypted Swiss cloud storage with zero recurring monthly subscription fees.

title: Namecheap – Affordable Domains & Web Hosting
text: Register .com, .org, and tech domains with free lifetime WhoisGuard privacy protection and reliable DNS.

title: Support Open-Source Software
text: Love free software? Consider donating to open-source maintainers on GitHub Sponsors or Liberapay to keep the tools you rely on free forever.
